title: Instagram Comment Sentiment Analyzer Input
description: Configure which Instagram posts to analyze and how many comments to process.

postUrls.title: Instagram Post URLs
postUrls.description: List of Instagram post URLs to scrape comments from. Supports /p/, /reel/, and /tv/ URLs.

maxComments.title: Max Comments Per Post
maxComments.description: Maximum number of comments to scrape per post. Set to 0 for all comments.

includeReplies.title: Include Reply Comments
includeReplies.description: Whether to also scrape and analyze replies to top-level comments.

sentimentEngine.title: Sentiment Analysis Engine
sentimentEngine.description: Choose the sentiment analysis method. 'basic' uses the Sentiment library (fast, free). 'enhanced' uses Natural NLP library for deeper analysis.

language.title: Comment Language
language.description: Primary language of comments for better sentiment accuracy. Use ISO 639-1 codes.

minLikes.title: Minimum Likes Filter
minLikes.description: Only analyze comments with at least this many likes. Set to 0 to include all.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for accessing Instagram. Apify Proxy is recommended.
